# Sonar
> A HarmonyOS music client compatible with SonicAPI and Subsonic servers such as Navidrome.
Canonical project page: https://projects.imba97.dev/projects/sonar/
GitHub: https://github.com/imba97/sonar
Status: documented candidate
Last verified: 2026-11-17
## English documentation
- [Sonar — project overview](https://projects.imba97.dev/projects/sonar/): A HarmonyOS music client compatible with SonicAPI and Subsonic servers such as Navidrome.
- [Sonar architecture](https://projects.imba97.dev/projects/sonar/architecture/): Runtime boundaries, package roles, and design facts for Sonar.
- [Sonar FAQ](https://projects.imba97.dev/projects/sonar/faq/): Common questions about Sonar, its intended use, setup, runtime boundary, and source of truth.
- [Sonar getting started](https://projects.imba97.dev/projects/sonar/getting-started/): Install and run Sonar from its source repository, then verify the first local workflow.
